name: flagport
description: An open-source server that speaks the LaunchDarkly SDK protocol, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e.mjs && node test/e2e-client.mjs && node test/e2e-workspaces.mjs && node test/e2e-access.mjs && node test/e2e-changes.mjs && node test/e2e-webhooks.mjs
scripts.test:browser: mkdir -p test/browser/vendor && cp node_modules/launchdarkly-js-client-sdk/dist/ldclient.min.js test/browser/vendor/ldclient-v3.min.js && cp node_modules/@launchdarkly/js-client-sdk/dist/index.js test/browser/vendor/ldclient-v4.js && python3 -m http.server 48790 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory test/browser
scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:app
